text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival. With the 
event to welcome Umamusume fans to Tracen 
Academy right around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make everyone smile," huh. 
Kita-san, what a wonderful dream!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd like to consult with you. I 
think this is a good opportunity, so we 
should all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After consulting with the volunteer 
members, I gave the green light without 
hesitation. And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeeh, a stage where I'm the main star 
at the Fan Appreciation Festival~?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep! The title of the show is 'Kitasan 
Black Sings Her Heart Out'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It's a two-part special stage. As its 
center, I expect you to fulfill your duty 
to the fans."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
I'm leaving the troupe leader role to you, 
Kitasan.

I'm leaving the troupe leader role to you, 
Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I'm honored! I'll... I'll give it 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fan service outside the racecourse is 
important too. Let's have them perform to 
their heart's content, just like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, you guys ready!? Part one is 
the raaaace!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy this dream race you wouldn't 
normally get to see!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the eight-person race began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san...!? Challenging me right from 
the start... This speed...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, not bad at all. To think that guy 
who looked like whitebait last year...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone realized it, her running had 
become just as good as the 
upperclassmen's. And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Part two is the live performance! Singing 
so many songs in front of everyone feels 
like a dream!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here's my song! Starting with the intro 
monologue!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa-whoa-whoa! Whoa, 
whoa, whoa, whoa-whoa-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Finalllllly, we meet at laaaaast, 
everyoneeeeeee♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Kita-chan, aren't you straining a 
bit too hard?
choice_data_list: Well, that's all part of the charm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black continued belting out one 
enka song after another, and—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Endleeeessly stretchiiing ooon! Winning 
the Soooouuuulll♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
EARTHLY DESIRE SPEEEEEEED! It's making my 
body boil up so hooooot!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-It's kind of becoming a habit. Now, 
nothing else will satisfy me...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Did you mess up the lyrics just now? For 
a second, I thought I saw the head 
priest..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Total singing time: two and a half hours. 
Kitasan Black brought the recital to a 
triumphant close alongside her friends.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(So many people were overjoyed. Seeing so 
many smiles...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(—This is it. What I've really wanted to 
do all along... is this!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Running, singing, becoming one. Getting 
hyped together with everyone...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(So from here on out... No, from here on 
out is the real—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Thank you sooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the curtain fell, Kitasan Black 
stepped outside the stage area and—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming today! Please 
let me shake your hand. Thank you from the 
bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please come to the racetrack, too! We'll 
put on a show that won't lose to today's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Seeing off every single person... To see 
the Thanksgiving Festival through to the 
very end like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How admirable, Trainer. No, rather than 
admirable—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this is in the blood as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, distinguished houses carry 
distinguished bloodlines, and those who 
inherit that blood strive to fulfill their 
destiny. Just like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san has her own blood coursing 
through her veins. An instinctual flow of 
blood that makes her want to devote 
herself to everyone's happiness.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Thank you, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Kitasan Black continue to express 
her gratitude without cutting any corners, 
one truly feels that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to bring joy to everyone." That 
sentiment connects directly to tomorrow's 
race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And after the performance, when Kitasan 
Black went outside the venue to see them 
off—"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There are still this many people...!? 
Did nobody go home?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black! Thanks for today! It was 
super fun!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you to come out! Now 
that the star has arrived, let's wrap this 
up with a clap!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what is this...?
choice_data_list: They seem like really devoted fans.

They look like pretty passionate fans, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's popularity was steadily 
spreading through grassroots support. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, a sea of people fills the area 
outside the venue. Her virtue and 
popularity are deeply taking root.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on a truly successful 
performance today! Now then, everyone, 
clap your hands together!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
A toast to Kitasan Black-san's future! 
Yoooooo-osh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Sha-sha-shan, sha-sha-shan, 
sha-sha-shan-shan!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhythmic, lively clapping echoed all 
around. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle*, *BA-BA-BOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks?! Even something like this, just 
for me...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you're quite adored, aren't you, 
Kita-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black once went unnoticed. Yet 
now, so many people are cheering for her.

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
We're counting on you, our Kitasan! Show 
us our dream this spring!

text_block_list.name: Fan F
text_block_list.text: Kitasan, I want you to win!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Yes... everyone! I'll... do my 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know I still fall short in a lot of 
ways, but please take good care of me for 
a long time to come!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The thunderous applause and cheers echoed 
endlessly. It became a wonderful event 
where the Umamusume and fans expressed 
their mutual gratitude.
